title: Separate closed Galerkin volume preservation from weighted squeezing
statement: For finite real mean-zero divergence-free Fourier E and mean-zero backgroundw,A=P_E L_w P_E has trace0 because every Fourier contribution shifts by a nonzero wavevector. Its exact CLOSED inviscid propagator has detT=1. For any R>0,the squared singular values of R^1/2 T R^-1/2 have product1,so tr(R^-1 T*RT)>=dimE. Hence no probability mixture of such blocks satisfies a strict averaged-amplitude inequality sum p_j T_j*RT_j<=(1-gamma)R. The prior conditional trace-derandomization lemma remains correct but lacks that premise for these blocks. On the actual Sobolev target,||T J_E||>=det(J_E)^(1/dimE),whose full-cube geometric mean is order1/N and tends to0; no WE/common-force impossibility follows. Full-flow compressions need not preserve determinant and require paid tail/backflow. Actual viscosity gives detT(t)=exp(nu t trDelta_E),which alone bounds neither largest singular value nor nonlinear error.
